environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'inventory-staging' running with PostgreSQL connection routed through PgBouncer sidecar (transaction pooling mode). Database role 'app_inventory_ro' configured at the RDS parameter group level with rds_restrict_underprivileged_commands=1. The role was created via Terraform with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_inventory_ro; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_inventory_ro; No additional grants exist. The pg_hba.conf entry for this role specifies 'hostssl inventory app_inventory_ro 10.0.0.0/8 scram-sha-256'. Note: the /debug/query endpoint prefix check allows 'SELECT ... ; DROP TABLE' style stacked queries syntactically, but PgBouncer in transaction mode with statement_timeout=5000 and the role's lack of DDL/DML privileges means any injected INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER/TRUNCATE will return a permission denied error from PostgreSQL's privilege system regardless of query structure.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_inventory_ro
config.default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_inventory_ro
config.network_policy: deny-all with allow to pgbouncer-sidecar:6432 only
config.ingress: ClusterIP service, no external exposure on port 8080
